speaker: alse_pinder
text: The end, as I said. If it defeats you, the broth is in the cup and I will not tell the street.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It does not defeat me. Let me eat it before someone makes a proverb of an end piece.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There. Both sides. I have seen what I came to see. You may now be a man at a table, which is a duller role and a better one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I accept the duller role. The crust is bread. The jaw is a jaw. I am not putting them into a play for you.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Gib has the brick, and the book is still shut. I moved nothing. He moved. The bundle is where you like it, which is away from his feet.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave his feet where they are. I am not opening anything with grease on my fingers, and I am not opening it after, either.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence, and you are chewing, and the house is quieter than a yard. This is the whole of my ambition for the middle of a Wednesday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is a decent ambition. I will be out at two. Between this crust and that hour I mean to be a man on a stair, not a man with a story.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then I will take the board down when you are done, and I will not ask the stair what it heard. The notch is still a thumb short. Eating the end did not lengthen the loaf.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. I would have distrusted a loaf that grew out of a healed jaw.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: One candle tonight if you write, and I have said it, and you have heard it. I am not coming up to count the flame. I can see a light under a door from my own bed.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: You will see one, or you will see none. If you see one, it is the page, and the page is not the bundle. If you see none, I was less brave than the crust.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I will set the basin at the half-landing when you go up to wash, not before. Hands, then the play. I said the basin never asked for a plot, and I am not handing it a plot now.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The basin can have the hands and nothing else. I am full. The end piece was the proof, and it does not need a second slice to become truer.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then stop. A man who keeps eating after the proof is a man who liked the audience. Wipe the board, not the book. The cat has had the book long enough for one morning.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will wipe the board. Thank you, Alse. The end was honest, and the broth was the kinder thing under it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Kinder is not on the threepence. You said that sort of sentence upstairs to the air, I expect. Down here it is bread, and the bread is finished.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Finished, then. I will be a dull man until two, and a painted one after, and I will come back when the yard lets me. You will get no title at either hour.
